audit.whatIsWrong: Every whys[] string contradicts its own chart row: whys[0] through whys[4] all say 'even skill' while the rows read Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Sejuani; whys[5] and whys[6] say 'favours Tryndamere' while the rows read Sejuani and Skill.
audit.why: The side rows in both layers already agree with each other and with the mirror audit (Tryndamere levels 1-5, Sejuani at 6 and first item, Skill at two items), so the prose is the layer that is wrong. Left the rows alone and rewrote the whys.
audit.corrected: All seven whys[] restated to match their rows.

audit.why: Glacial Prison at 6 is 120s at rank 1 and 1300 range against your 650 Spinning Slash; Undying Rage is 120/100/80. Her tank items blunt your first-item spike, which is why the chart hands 6 and first item to her before you retake the side lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: Permafrost is written as a tracked cooldown to bait, and spikes[3] calls it 'Permafrost passive damage'. Neither is right. Nothing anywhere mentions that Frost Armor grants immunity to slows.
audit.why: Permafrost is a 1.5s, 560-range ability that only stuns a target already at maximum Frost stacks — the gate is Winter's Wrath and her autos filling the stacks, not the E cooldown. Fury of the North grants Armor, Magic Resist and slow immunity out of combat, so Mocking Shout's back-turned slow does nothing until Frost Armor is broken; the passive also shatters a stunned target for heavy magic damage.
audit.corrected: The stack gate, the 1.5s cooldown, and Frost Armor's slow immunity written in.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sejuani is referred to as 'him'/'his' in breakdown.mid, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.late and report[12].
audit.why: Sejuani is female; the rest of the page uses 'her'.
audit.corrected: Flagged in notes — pronoun-only fixes, no mechanical content.

edits.before: Level 1 is even skill — Sejuani has no lane damage and you have no gap-closer.
edits.after: Level 1 favours Tryndamere — Sejuani has no lane damage and only Frost Armor.

edits.before: Level 2 is even skill — still a farm phase with only her Q engage to respect.
edits.after: Level 2 favours Tryndamere — only Arctic Assault threatens, and it is 18s.

edits.before: Level 3 is even skill — her W-Q combo can trade but has no kill threat 1v1.
edits.after: Level 3 favours Tryndamere — her Q-W trade chunks but has no kill threat.

edits.before: Level 4-5 is even skill — the tank phase continues with neither side able to force a kill.
edits.after: Level 4-5 favours Tryndamere — she cannot force a kill and your fury pattern is online.

edits.before: Level 6 is even skill — her R helps ganks but does nothing to win the direct duel.
edits.after: Level 6 favours Sejuani — Glacial Prison stuns from 1300 range and sets up the collapse.

edits.before: First item favours Tryndamere — crit and armor shred out-DPS her tank stats and shields.
edits.after: First item favours Sejuani — tank stats and Frost Armor blunt your crits before Infinity Edge.

edits.before: Two-plus items favours Tryndamere — you outscale a tank 1v1 and split-push as the win condition.
edits.after: Two-plus items is even skill — you outduel her in the side lane, she wins any fight her team joins.

edits.before: You outscale a tank 1v1 — split-push and R make you the win condition, and as long as you dodge her Q engage her Permafrost passive damage can't out-DPS your crits.
edits.after: You outscale a tank 1v1 — split-push and R make you the win condition, and if you never let Frost stacks fill, Permafrost never stuns and she cannot hold you.

edits.before: - Sejuani Permafrost: matchup-defining — Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Permafrost is only a 1.5s cooldown — the real gate is Frost stacks, so break off after Winter's Wrath rather than eating the second swing. - Arctic Assault: 18s at rank 1. - Undying Rage: 120s at rank 1 — kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Sejuani's Permafrost: Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. When it is down — Spin in, crit him down.
edits.after: Permafrost stuns only at full Frost stacks, and her passive shatters a stunned target — leave before Winter's Wrath fills them.

edits.before: Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Permafrost is a 1.5s cooldown — the gate is Frost stacks, so trade and leave before she fills them.

edits.before: That is Sejuani's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Mocking Shout's slow does nothing while Frost Armor holds — damage it off her first.

notes: The packet suspectName 'Land Arctic Assault' is a FALSE POSITIVE — correct name with a verb in front. Sejuani is called 'him'/'his' in breakdown.mid, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.late and report[12].t — pronoun-only, not edited here to avoid burning length band on non-mechanical text.
